title: Native containers: build set/ndarray results directly in the heap (no Rust-side double copy; heap-limit accounting), re-assess set.sample
description: Left from eu-oaz72.52 (PR #1234). (1) Set ops and ndarray results are built in a Rust Vec/ArrayD, then copied into the heap: two copies, and the transient buffer is outside --heap-limit-mib accounting. with_set copies twice; vec.slice and set.to-list do an extra to_vec; reshape could share the data backing. Needs a write-into-heap-buffer Array API (unsafe-adjacent; touches all ndarray intrinsics). (3) set.sample compares strings: re-assess now that sets are dict trees. neighbours_values could reuse the new direct-offset get. GC area: two independent reviews; measure under PROTOCOL.md (#1234 found the get/GC wins indistinguishable from noise, so justify by memory accounting first).
